description: Generate a round-robin fixture schedule for a set of teams. Use when needing a balanced, circular schedule. Avoid when needing a single matchday plan (use match_day_plan).

rounds.description: Optional number of rounds to return (1..full schedule)

second_leg.description: Also schedule the reverse fixtures for a double round-robin

name: round_robin_schedule

schedule.description: List of rounds in the schedule

bye.description: The team with a bye in this round (if any)

matches.description: List of matches in the round

title: Round robin schedule
